title: Ship reviewer output
description: What each Ship reviewer (Crit, Pol, Eye, Test, Adversarial) returns. bin/review.py validate enforces this plus the per-reviewer rules noted in descriptions. No numeric scores or confidence percentages: severity + evidence + confidence_reason.

skipped_reason.description: Required when status is skipped (e.g. no way to render the app).

fingerprint.description: Required in review mode: the snapshot tree from scope.json you reviewed.

model.description: Exact model ID from your environment section; null if not stated.

id.description: Prefixed with your reviewer name: crit-1, pol-2 …

evidence.description: At least one of file, screenshot, command (+output), quote. Eye findings always need screenshot.

line.description: One line or one range. More places → locations; a label → line_note.

screenshot.description: Path to a screenshot or recording you captured or were given.

output.description: Required with command: the relevant excerpt of what it printed.

quote.description: Exact text from a plan, decision, or registry file (plan mode, product decisions).

locations.description: Every other place the same root cause shows up — one finding, fixed once.

confidence_reason.description: Why you believe it: what you checked, and what you could not check.

result.description: pass/concerns = checked; not-applicable needs a reason in note; not-checked = applicable but unverified (the review is then partial)

artifacts.description: Eye: required unless skipped — screenshots/recordings looked at.

verdicts.description: Adversarial, review mode: one per first-wave finding it checked. Use the ids exactly as in merged.json.

notes.description: Questions, things you could not check, references you relied on.
